Contract ProcessSaleService::enterItem(barcode: Integer,quantity: Integer): Boolean {
	precondition:
		let item: Item = Item.allInstance()->any(o|o.Barcode = barcode and
		o.StockNumber>0) in
		CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		CurrentSale.IsComplete = false and
		item.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		item.StockNumber>=quantity and
		quantity>0
	postcondition:
		let sl: SalesLineItem in
		sl.oclIsNew() and
		CurrentSale.ContainedSalesLine->includes(sl) and
		sl.BelongedSale = CurrentSale and
		sl.BelongedItem.Barcode = barcode and
		sl.Quantity = quantity and
		sl.Subamount = sl.BelongedItem.Price*quantity and
		sl.BelongedItem.StockNumber = sl.BelongedItem.StockNumber-quantity and
		result = true
}
